definitions.explanation: A geometric shape with three sides and three angles.
Something having the shape of a triangle.

examples.japanese: {三角|さんかく}の{面積|めんせき}を{求|もと}める。
examples.english: I calculate the area of the triangle.

examples.japanese: {三角|さんかく}{定規|じょうぎ}で{線|せん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: I draw a line with a triangle ruler.

examples.japanese: {算数|さんすう}で{三角|さんかく}{形|けい}の{性質|せいしつ}について{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned about the properties of triangles in arithmetic class.

examples.japanese: おにぎりは{三角|さんかく}の{形|かたち}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Rice balls are often triangular in shape.

examples.japanese: {三角|さんかく}{形|けい}に{切|き}ってください。
examples.english: Please cut it into a triangular shape.

examples.japanese: {屋根|やね}が{三角|さんかく}の{形|かたち}をした{家|いえ}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Houses with triangular roofs are lined up.

notes:
{三角|さんかく} means triangle or triangular. Composed of {三|さん} (three) + {角|かく} (angle/corner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三角形|さんかくけい}: triangle (geometric term)
- {三角|さんかく}{定規|じょうぎ}: set square/triangle ruler
- {三角|さんかく}{関係|かんけい}: love triangle
- {三角|さんかく}{関数|かんすう}: trigonometric function

EVERYDAY USE:
- おにぎりの{三角|さんかく}: triangular rice ball shape
- {三角|さんかく}{巾|きん}: triangular bandage (first aid)

MATH USAGE:
In geometry: {三角形|さんかくけい}の{面積|めんせき} (area of a triangle). {三角|さんかく}{関数|かんすう} (trigonometric functions) appears in high school math.

RELATED SHAPES:
- {四角|しかく}: square/rectangle
- {丸|まる}: circle
